provenance.notes: The acm.org template page returned 403 (not readable). CTAN confirms the class acmart (v2.20, LPPL 1.3, in TeX Live and MiKTeX) but does not list its formats. The option [sigconf] and the ACM front matter (rights, CCS concepts) are from the acmart documentation and are NOT verified here. Many ACM conferences require review mode: add the `review` option and anonymize yourself.

anonymity.text: Depends on the conference; use the `anonymous,review` options when required.

facts.text: acmart is the ACM class (CTAN v2.20, LPPL 1.3).

compile_check.tool: tectonic 0.17.0 (TeX bundle with the real class file)
compile_check.result: The generated main.tex compiled without errors on a real 15-page paper and rendered in two columns. This shows the class name and option are accepted; it does not show that the venue accepts the result.
